mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlist WHERE u_idx = #{userIdx} AND b_idx = #{brnIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT b.b_idx AS brnIdx, b.b_name AS brnName, b.b_address AS brnAddress, b.b_description AS brnDescription, b.b_latitude AS brnLatitude, b.b_altitude AS brnLongitude, b.b_phone AS brnPhone, b.b_file AS brnFile, b.b_active AS brnActive, 1 AS isWish FROM branch b INNER JOIN wishlist w ON b.b_idx = w.b_idx WHERE w.u_idx = #{userIdx}
